dict.string: AirControl uses the camera to track your hand so you can point at and move windows with in-air gestures. All processing happens on-device; nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.

In mouse mode, pinch-holding on a text field turns the pinch into a push-to-talk button: AirControl listens only while you hold the pinch and types what you said. Audio is processed on-device and never recorded or sent anywhere.
AirControl transcribes your dictation on-device (Apple speech recognition with on-device mode) to type into the text field you pinched. Nothing leaves your Mac.
